findings.title: website_name is exposed to users for whom website is restricted
findings.body: `include_website_name` checks only `website.present?`, but `website` is listed in `untrusted_attributes`, so for TL0 users seen by anonymous/restricted scopes the `website` key is omitted. `website_name` is not in that list and its inclusion check reads the raw website, so it is still serialized and reveals the host (and path, when the domain matches the instance) of the hidden website. The spec's 'doesn't serialize untrusted attributes' test does not include `website_name`, so this is not caught. Fix by applying the same `scope.restrict_user_fields?(object)` guard, or by adding `website_name` to the untrusted attribute list.
